product: Creatine monohydrate powder, 4 g per day
dose_note: one serving/day maintenance; no loading phase specified

outcomes.name: Muscle strength
outcomes.population: healthy adults doing resistance training (mostly young males)
outcomes.sentence: With training, 3–5 g/day adds a small extra strength gain (SMD ~0.4; ~4 kg bench, 11 kg squat) vs placebo over 4–12 weeks.

ledger.effect_basis: Metas of 23+ RCTs show extra 4-11 kg 1RM or SMD 0.2-0.5 vs RT+placebo; 3-5 g/d typical.
ledger.effective_daily_range: 3-5 g/day maintenance (loading 20 g x 5-7 d optional)

effect.found: Small extra strength gain versus training alone.
effect.missing: Large effects; data in women and in people who do not train.

evidence.found: Consistent meta-analyses, aligned with ISSN, NIH ODS and EFSA.
evidence.missing: Very large, long trials — and trials in trained women.

form.found: Monohydrate was used in nearly all trials.

dose.found: 4 g/day sits inside the 3–5 g maintenance range.
dose.missing: No loading phase, but 4+ weeks of maintenance still works.

inventory.note: 23 RCTs adults <50 +RT; +4.43 kg upper +11.35 kg lower 1RM
NIH ODS: may increase strength/power; 3-5 g/d after load

outcomes.strongest_study: Wang 2024 Nutrients meta-analysis of 23 RCTs with resistance training in under-50s
outcomes.strongest_doubt: Small n per trial, possible water/weight confound, weaker in women
outcomes.study_that_would_move_this: 200+ mixed-sex 6–12 month RCT of 4 g/day vs placebo with supervised training, 1RM and MRI

outcomes.name: Lean body mass
outcomes.sentence: Adds about 1 kg extra lean mass vs training + placebo — partly water; true muscle growth on imaging is very small.

ledger.effect_basis: Metas +1.1 kg LBM with RT; imaging shows trivial-small true muscle. 3-5 g/d.

effect.found: ~1 kg extra lean mass; small gains in muscle size on imaging.
effect.missing: Proof it is contractile tissue rather than water.

form.found: Monohydrate is the standard tested form.

dose.found: 4 g matches the maintenance dose used.

inventory.note: 35 RCTs; +1.10 kg LBM with RT any age
10 RCTs imaging hypertrophy SMD 0.11 very small
5 g wash-in +12 wk RT; extra LBM only in wash-in

outcomes.strongest_study: Delpino 2022 Nutrition meta-analysis: +1.1 kg LBM with training
outcomes.strongest_doubt: Lean mass is partly intracellular water; imaging effect tiny
outcomes.study_that_would_move_this: Large RCT of 4 g/day + training vs placebo with DXA plus MRI over 6+ months

outcomes.name: Cognitive function
outcomes.sentence: No meaningful benefit in healthy young adults; small memory effects appear mainly in older or stressed people.

ledger.effect_basis: Young healthy subgroup SMD ~0; EFSA 2024 no cause-effect; 4 g may be low for brain.
ledger.effective_daily_range: 5-20 g/day (often short high-dose or loading for brain)

effect.found: Null in young healthy adults; small memory effect in older or stressed people.
effect.missing: Any clear benefit at this dose in this group.
effect.move: Cognition RCTs in young adults at 4 g.

evidence.found: EFSA rejected the claim; young-adult subgroup is null.
evidence.missing: Well-powered trials in healthy young adults at 4 g.

dose.found: 4 g is near 5 g, but many cognition studies used 20 g short-term.

inventory.note: 16 RCTs mixed; memory SMD 0.31 but healthy attention ns
8 RCTs memory; young SMD 0.03 ns vs older 0.88
EFSA: no cause-effect for cognitive function

outcomes.strongest_study: Prokopidis 2022 Nutrition Reviews: memory null in young adults
outcomes.strongest_doubt: Effects confined to older, diseased or stressed people; 4 g likely too low for the brain
outcomes.study_that_would_move_this: Large double-blind RCT of 4 g/day in young healthy adults on memory/attention over 8+ weeks
